definition: A hypothetical survey counts 75,000 employed people, including 3,100 working part time for economic reasons; 4,500 unemployed; and 1,800 marginally attached people outside the labor force. What is U-6 labor underutilization? Round to 2 decimal places.
explanation: U-6 = (unemployed + marginally attached + involuntary part-time)/(labor force + marginally attached). Thus (4,500 + 1,800 + 3,100)/(75,000 + 4,500 + 1,800) × 100 = 11.56%. Part-time workers are already included among employed people.
